full_page.content:
Page 39 Cont.
Apr. 5 Patrick H. Kenney - 40 - heart condition threatening - has been care- less regarding practice of religion .... Prayers asked for grace of Happy Death
Anthony Sender - 35 - has been good provider for two little children Recently has been going to "beer-gardens" etc, and neglecting his duties every way
Waller - 49 - heart-trouble in St. Joseph Mercy - Wife anxious. .
Page 40 April 6 Little Flower - Hurd Flerlin Restorium ..... 1260 E. Br. Blvd.
Harold Eland - 9 - has no conscience - steals .... lies .... parents desperate
Mrs. Jacob Fisher of Rose City Michig. Enrolled March 21 and again three days later as against hopeless cancer .......... Operation con- sisted in doctors opening up stomach etc and in sheer hopelessness of being able to do anything sewed her up ..... she is recovering able to be about
Hilda Rolasid - 30 - (?) lutheran
Mrs. Annetta Shankin - 31 - fearful case of arthritis; for 7 yrs. un- able to bend legs. Much of the time in great pain. Has two little girls 8 & 11 and rather discouraged husband ..... wants divorce ..... even threatens ..... Enrolled To-day - promising perp. .
Mrs. Eleanore Radtke - 50 - fears she is possessed. .
Page 41 Apr. 8 Peter Manici - 28 - Epiletic - near four years ..... 6 fits daly
9 Mrs. Eliz. Scrage - Toledo, 0. - about 48 - broke arm (falling down cellar) in 8 places - neighbor - Mrs. Elicker - Enrolled her March 19 - three weeks ago ..... Drs. surprised no infection set in - arm com- ing O.K.
11 Mrs. Josephine Cadden - 48 - threatening tuomer enrolled Feb. Ist Enrolled promissing more frequent Communion - in fact going dayly since ..... No operation necessary - Enrolled To-day as perpetual Member. Deo Gr.
